name: bringup-f-air-txrx
about: F-AIR ladder (wifi-dp-air merge, task-126): the one-command first-air-TX/RX session on the MERGED module = mode-1 provider (wifi-scan-ap + wifi-vap-start provider patch + scan-complete) + the E1 MAC data-plane bring-up + the wifi-dp-txrx first-TX/RX actions. Boot -> one ordered context-create (g0 id1 key 0x64 t1) -> one TXQ sync (72-byte node) -> iw iface add + link up (provider user_add/notify) -> ONE iw scan (provider vap_add g0 id1 key 0x64 + vap_start key 0x65 + scan_req g0 id0xC; the firmware VAP object and radio channel are the air-TX precondition) -> read-only dp_probe -> ONE dp_setup (E1 rings/table/MAC program) -> ONE 0x0320 TXQ-table address sync -> FIRST DATA-PLANE TX (8-byte MSDU ring entry + device-RAM table wptr publish) -> read-only completion/status -> ONE read-only RX capture -> post packs. PASS/POST-ONLY/NO-RX are explicit outcomes: only the completion read rules decide COMPLETED vs POST-ONLY, and an on-air observation additionally needs an external observer (documented in the lane ladder). HOST-ONLY delivery: this lane was not fired at the device.

steps.name: note-ladder
steps.about: F-AIR ladder for the merged provider module (opensource/docs/incoming/wifi-dp-air, hi5622_wifi.ko built by that lane's tools/build.sh; record size/sha256 from BUILD-NOTES.md and compare with sha256sum on the box - a mismatch is a STOP). Preconditions: attended session, recovery door READY, read-only UART capture, PD4 firmware + local Wi-Fi block staged, cfg80211.ko loaded first. One boot = one idea: ONE ctx-create, ONE txq_sync72, ONE scan, ONE dp_setup, ONE 0x0320, at most TWO TX posts, ONE RX capture; no retry, no rmmod after the 0x5A5A release.

steps.name: cfg-status
steps.about: wiphy registered after the ready handshake (cfg80211 preamble already waits for /sys/class/ieee80211; this is the sequence-local re-gate)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: pre-create state on this fresh boot: no context, exception mask 0, exception staging 0

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: H2D frame 1/3: ONE context-create (g0 id1 key 0x64, data[0]=type 1) - the ordered precondition of the TXQ sync, the provider VAP/scan frame family and the data-plane setup/hand-off

steps.name: post-create
steps.about: the create allocated the measured ctx4 body (same PACK as the hardware-validated C2/D2 rows: ctx4[0]=4, ctx4+0x10=0x00010001, ctx4+0x434=0x0100478C)

steps.name: txq-sync72
steps.about: H2D frame 2/3: ONE TXQ config sync (g0 id1 cmd 0xd8, 72-byte node) -> core ACTIVE before the provider VAP/scan sequence (vap_start_first=1 needs the ACTIVE phase)

steps.name: post-txq
steps.about: the TXQ handler ran clean: exception mask and staging word stay 0

steps.name: vap-add
steps.about: iw phy phy0 interface add wlan0 type managed -> add_virtual_intf -> provider user_add g0 id7 180 B + user_add_notify g0 id8 180 B (hardware validated 2026-11-26)

steps.name: link-up
steps.about: bring the managed netdev up; nl80211 refuses the scan request on a down interface

steps.name: vap-added
steps.about: the driver VAP model recorded the real wlan0 netdev

steps.name: catalog-baseline
steps.about: D2H catalogue before the scan/data-plane ladder (evidence baseline)

steps.name: scan
blocked_patterns: scan needs an H2D frame provider
steps.about: ONE nl80211 scan: the provider posts vap_add g0 id1 48 B + vap_start g0 id1 40 B + scan_req g0 id0xC 520 B (hardware validated 2026-11-26; firmware pace ~3.5 s/channel so the auto window finishes with a channel-coverage or finish-abort result and results>0). This step is BOTH the mode-1 firmware VAP creation and the radio channel selection - the air-TX precondition. iw rc=0 also holds for an ABORTED scan (results>0 is gated by scan-results below).

steps.name: scan-settle
steps.about: bounded wait for the last firmware scan events to reach the direct reader and the driver's scan-done log

steps.name: scan-results
steps.about: PASS gate: the scan finished (ok or abort) and parsed at least one firmware result (g1 id15/17), so the firmware VAP object exists and the radio has a channel. BLOCKED-DRIVER: the scan was accepted but produced results=0 - the firmware produced nothing (the known VAP/scan-state wall), so the air-TX precondition is not met and the ladder must NOT claim a data-plane verdict

steps.name: scan-dmesg
steps.about: PASS gate: the cfg80211 scan event handler logged at least one 'scan channel result slot=.. ch=..' line (g1 id17 decode). BLOCKED-DRIVER: only the driver's own results=0 abort line is present

steps.name: dp-probe
steps.about: read-only reachability word of MAC band 0 +0x00 (one read, no write); it must PASS before dp_setup is allowed in this load

steps.name: dp-setup
steps.about: E1 (hardware-validated 2026-11-26): allocate the 0x2524 TXQ table, the 8x64x8 TX MSDU-info rings, tx_ba_info and the 256/512/4095 RX rings + 0x63c/0xb0 buffer pools; write the 8 device-RAM MSDU table entries {ring devVA,0,0}; program MAC band 0 with read-back. ONE action, no retry; a read-back mismatch closes the data-plane lane for this load.

steps.name: dp-rings-check
steps.about: read-only MAC band 0 snapshot + device-RAM table read-out: the two free-ring write pointers published 0x8000 and the vendor interrupt mask 0xfffffcc1 are visible

steps.name: pre-tx-status
steps.about: the txrx layer bound to this load's E1 objects at the end of dp_setup; no frame posted yet

steps.name: dp-txq-sync
steps.about: H2D frame 3/3 and the data-plane hand-off: ONE g0 id1 key 0x0320 frame carrying the 4-byte device VA of the host-DRAM TXQ table (firmware worker CA 0x81445 stores it). The TX action gates on this commit; no retry.

steps.name: tx-frame-probe-req
steps.about: FIRST DATA-PLANE TX: 32-B broadcast probe request (802.11 mgmt, no FCS) into the coherent buffer [owner][16 B zero DMA header][MPDU]; 8-B MSDU entry for user 0/TID 0 slot 0 {buf devVA, ctl(len,tid0,vap1,hdr)}; dma_wmb; publish packed wptr 0->1 into the device-RAM 12-B table entry dword1 and read back all three dwords. One frame, no retry; broadcast has no ACK dependency.

steps.name: tx-status-1
steps.about: the post landed (entry + table wptr read back). completion_pending = distance(device rptr, published wptr): 0 = the MAC consumed the entry and wrote table dword2 (TX COMPLETED); 1 = POST-ONLY (host path proven, device did not consume). The completion read is NOT a gate: both are recorded outcomes

steps.name: tx-frame-null
steps.about: second frame (optional discrimination): 24-B broadcast null-data (data class, vap type 2) at ring slot 1 - settles the [I] ctl vap-type/header-flag mapping against the mgmt frame

steps.name: tx-status-2
steps.about: both entries posted; completion_pending is captured as evidence for the COMPLETED vs POST-ONLY classification

steps.name: rx-poll
steps.about: ONE read-only RX observation: bounded 2000 ms poll of MAC band 0 +0x4c (completion producer), then a scan of the host-DRAM 256 norm + 512 small RX buffers for the 0x28-B device descriptor. Moves NO ring pointer, reposts nothing; 0 completions is a recorded NO-RX outcome, never a gate

steps.name: rx-capture
steps.about: the captured evidence (MAC completion/norm/small counters, raw completion word, descriptor + up to 128 MPDU bytes) is read back; captures>0 with desc_ok=1 and a plausible 802.11 FC byte is the RX-descriptor evidence needed to decode the completion format in a later boot

steps.name: post-pack
steps.about: hard stop gate: no firmware exception and the golden handshake survived the provider ladder + MAC program + TX posts + RX capture

steps.name: h2d-summary
steps.about: all three H2D frames (ctx-create, txq_sync72, key-0x0320 hand-off) were consumed; none was refused or timed out

steps.name: catalog-after
steps.about: post-run D2H catalogue delta (the TX entries have no known D2H answer; evidence only)

steps.name: note-end
steps.about: F-AIR verdict: COMPLETED = posted frames landed AND completion_pending=0 (MAC consumed the MSDU entries); POST-ONLY = posted and completion_pending=1 for the whole read (host->ring->table path proven, MAC did not consume); NO-RX = RX capture polled with 0 completions (expected until the RX completion-word format is decoded); BLOCKED-DRIVER = the scan produced results=0 (no firmware VAP) so no air TX can be attempted. On-air proof additionally needs an external observer (second station / monitor) - the merged ladder can only prove the host/MAC completion chain on its own. STOP after this boot: no retry, no reload in the same attended session, recovery door armed.
